coarse_tags.data_io: Data loading, cleaning, encoding, type conversion, missing value handling, normalization
coarse_tags.feature_eng: Derived features, feature selection, transformations, embeddings, target encoding
coarse_tags.model_def: Model architecture definition — class instantiation, backbone, head, layers, config
coarse_tags.training_cfg: Training loop, optimizer, scheduler, loss function, callbacks, hyperparameters, early stopping
coarse_tags.ensemble_blend: Multi-model combination — weighted average, stacking, blending, multi-seed averaging
coarse_tags.validation_cv: Cross-validation strategy, OOF predictions, evaluation metrics, fold scheme
coarse_tags.inference_submit: Prediction logic, post-processing, TTA, threshold tuning, submission file generation
coarse_tags.infra_util: Paths, environment, imports, logging, seed setting, GPU config, utility functions

fine_tag_policy_description: LLM should prefer tags from the seed list but may propose new tags when none fit. New tags must have a parent coarse tag.
notes: Iteration 0 — zero-shot, no few-shot exemplars. Schema will be refined after analyzing outputs.
